subject: Request: Audit rights & DPIA evidence for BridgePoint onboarding
messages:
From: Juraj Novak <juraj.novak@bridgepointhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-11T08:12:00-04:00
Subject: Initial DPIA / audit rights ask for onboarding

Hi Karthik and Lauren,

We're kicking off BridgePoint's security and privacy review ahead of contract signature. Procurement asked me to collect the following from Redwood to complete our DPIA and procurement packet:

- Confirmed audit rights scope (on-site and remote) and typical notice windows
- Art. 28/30 processing ledger extract (example output is fine) showing subprocessors and processing categories
- SOC2 summary / latest cert date and high-level statement on exception handling
- Response to DPIA questionnaire attached (we filled sections A–C; please complete owner fields)

Can you confirm whether you can provide those items within 72 hours? Our legal team needs the packet to finalize the DPA addendum. Attach: BridgePoint_DPIA_Questionnaire_20281011.pdf (filled where possible).

Thanks,
Juraj
Head of Procurement
BridgePoint Health
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Juraj Novak <juraj.novak@bridgepointhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-11T09:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPIA / audit rights ask for onboarding

Hi Juraj — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested materials; a couple clarifications so we meet your needs:

1) Audit rights: our standard DPA allows remote audits and a single on-site visit per year with 14 days' notice. If BridgePoint requires additional on-site frequency or expanded scope, that is typically brokered in a reserved-capacity SOW (we can discuss).

2) Ledger extract: we can provide an Art.30-style CSV showing subprocessors, processing categories, locations, and transfer mechanisms. Will that be sufficient, or do you need the full dependency tree (code-level integrations)?

3) DPIA questionnaire: we've started filling the file; attaching a draft response and SOC2 summary. If you need encrypted transfer, let us know.

Looping in Marissa (Account Lead) and Marcus (Security) to pull the ledger extract and finalize the questionnaire answers. Targeting delivery by EOD tomorrow (2028-10-12).

Best,
Karthik
Director, Legal & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-11T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: BridgePoint DPIA packet — action items (high priority)

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding Juraj's packet. Short checklist: 

- Marissa: compile commercial-facing packet (DPIA questionnaire final PDF, SOC2 summary, brief note on audit notice windows).
- Marcus: produce Art.30 ledger extract (CSV) containing subprocessors, processing categories, data transfers, and legal basis; include a short memo on how we handle transfer safeguards (SCCs / onshore routing).

Timeline: Juraj asked for 72 hours. We committed to EOD tomorrow. Please prioritize — Procurement will gate signature on DPA addendum. If any item requires escalation (e.g., custom on-site audit frequency), flag immediately.

Attachments to produce (stubs acceptable for initial delivery): redwood_art30-ledger-extract-20281011.csv, redwood-soc2-summary-2028Q3.pdf.

Thanks — Karthik

On 2028-10-11 Juraj Novak <juraj.novak@bridgepointhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Karthik and Lauren,
>
> We're kicking off BridgePoint's security and privacy review ahead of contract signature....
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Juraj Novak <juraj.novak@bridgepointhealth.com>, procurement@bridgepointhealth.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-12T15:03:00-04:00
Subject: BridgePoint onboarding: DPIA packet and Art.30 extract (delivery)

Hi Juraj / Procurement team,

Thanks for the patience — attached are the items we discussed:

- redwood_art30-ledger-extract-20281011.csv (CSV export showing subprocessors, processing categories, locations, and transfer mechanisms).
- redwood-soc2-summary-2028Q3.pdf (one-page summary; full report available under NDA).
- Completed BridgePoint_DPIA_Questionnaire_20281011.pdf (we've filled Owner fields and added clarifying notes in section D).

Key notes:
- Audit rights: Redwood supports remote audits and one on-site inspection per 12 months with 14 days' advance notice. For broader audit cadences or additional control tests, we can add an audit appendix to the DPA or include a mutually agreed SOW.
- Transfers: Subprocessors located in the US and EU are listed; for EU transfers we reference SCCs (2021 standard clauses) and deploy onshore routing where requested for regulated workloads.
- DPIA support: we can provide a short 60–90 minute walkthrough with our Privacy Engineer to review the ledger and answers; propose Wed 2028-10-17 at 10:00 AM CET.

Attachments: BridgePoint_DPIA_Questionnaire_20281011.pdf, redwood_art30-ledger-extract-20281011.csv, redwood-soc2-summary-2028Q3.pdf

If you want the ledger in a different format or a signed SOC2 certificate copy, tell us and we'll coordinate a secure transfer (DocuSign / SharePoint / encrypted S3).

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: BridgePoint_DPIA_Questionnaire_20281011.pdf (filled), redwood_art30-ledger-extract-20281011.csv (stub), redwood-soc2-summary-2028Q3.pdf (summary)
